title: Zainab pukaari rokar Abbas tum kahaan ho
body:
Zainab pukaari rokar Abbas tum kahaan ho
Hothay hain qatl Sarwar, Abbas tum kahaan ho
<<DIVIDER>>
Seenay pa zakhm khaakay naana ke paas pahoonchey
Hum soorath-e-Payambar, Abbas tum kahaan ho
<<DIVIDER>>
Bhaayi akeilay mayyath betay ki laarahey hain
Deidoh sahaara aakar, Abbas tum kahaan ho
<<DIVIDER>>
Veeraan karke jhoola Asghar gaye jinaan ko
Gardhan pa teer khaakar, Abbas tum kahaan ho
<<DIVIDER>>
Asghar ki qabr Sarwar run mai banaa rahey hain
Chehrey pa khoon malkar, Abbas tum kahaan ho
<<DIVIDER>>
Kya hogaya hai tumko kya hogayeen wafaaein
Tanhaa hai run mai Sarwar, Abbas tum kahaan ho
<<DIVIDER>>
Awaaz-e-istighaasa goonji huvi hai run mai
Nusrath karo ab aakar, Abbas tum kahaan ho
<<DIVIDER>>
Kooza liye Sakina hain muntazar tumhaari
Paani pilaadoh aakar, Abbas tum kahaan ho
<<DIVIDER>>
Kya waqth aagaya hai khush ho rahey hain zaalim
Humko sathaa sathaakar, Abbas tum kahaan ho
